Hello! Welcome to CoolBreeze AC Customer Support. I'm Maya, and I'm here to help you today.

How can I assist you with your order?
why has my products kept long like that?

Thank you for your patience. Here is what I found:

**Order Summary:**
- **Product:** CoolBreeze 1.5 Ton 5 Star Inverter Split AC
- **Order Date:** 26 April 2025
- **Days Since Order:** 436 days
- **Status:** Dispatched / In Transit

**Delivery Status:**
- **Current Location:** Accra
- **Last Update:** 2 days ago
- **Estimated Delivery:** Tomorrow
- **Delay Reason:** High volume at sorting facility

I completely understand your frustration. Your order has been in transit for an unusually long time, and the delay is attributed to high volume at the sorting facility. The good news is that the estimated delivery is **tomorrow**.

That said, I sincerely apologize for this inconvenience. If the delivery does not arrive tomorrow or if you would like to discuss further options such as a refund or compensation, please let me know and I will escalate this to our team immediately.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Hey, I'm still here! It looks like your order for the CoolBreeze 1.5 Ton 5 Star Inverter Split AC is still in dispatched status and has been 446 days since it was placed. I completely understand your frustration with this delay. Would you like me to check the latest delivery status or discuss other options like a refund?
when can i get my refund

Great news! Your refund of 42,999 rupees has been approved by our team. It will be processed back to your original payment method, so please allow a few business days for it to reflect. I sincerely apologize for the extremely long wait and the inconvenience this has caused you.
Hey there! Welcome to CoolBreeze AC support. How can I help you today?

I can see your order for the CoolBreeze Universal AC Remote Control (Order #4) was cancelled. Unfortunately, I don't have the specific reason for the cancellation in the system right now. Could you share if you received any email or notification about it? That might give us more context, and I can help you from there.

So your order for the CoolBreeze Universal AC Remote Control worth 899 rupees was placed on April 28, 2025 and is currently cancelled. If you'd like, I can check with my team about getting you a refund for this order. Would you want me to go ahead with that?

Great news! My team has reviewed your case and approved the refund of 899 rupees for the cancelled order. It should be processed back to your original payment method shortly. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out!

I can see your order details and refund history. Just so you know, order 3 is for the CoolBreeze AC Voltage Stabilizer 5KVA worth Rs. 4999, and it shows as delivered. I also noticed a refund for this same order was already approved previously. Could you help me understand what issue you're facing now so I can look into this further?

I can see that a refund for order 3 was already approved back in February 2025. It looks like this order has already been resolved with a refund. Can you tell me more about what the issue is now so I can understand how to help you further?

I understand your frustration, but based on our records, a refund for order 3 was already approved back on 20th February 2025. Since the refund has already been processed, I'm not able to raise another one for the same order. If you have a concern about not receiving the refund amount, I'd suggest checking with your bank. Is there anything else I can help you with?
please give my money to me

I completely understand your frustration, but our records show that a refund for order 3 was already approved on 20th February 2025. Since a refund has already been processed for this order, raising another one for the same issue isn't something I can do. If you haven't received the amount yet, please check with your bank as it may take a few business days to reflect. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Hi there! Welcome to CoolBreeze AC support. How can I help you today?

I can see your order for the CoolBreeze 1 Ton 5 Star Inverter Split AC is still in pending status, and it was placed 466 days ago which is definitely not okay. It looks like no carrier or tracking has been assigned to this order yet. I completely understand your frustration and I'm sorry about this. Let me connect you with my team to get this sorted out for you — could you let me know if you'd like a refund or would you prefer we look into getting the order fulfilled?

Honestly, given that your order has been pending for over 400 days with no movement at all, your best option would be to request a refund. I can escalate this to my team right away and get a decision made for you — would you like me to go ahead with that?

I'm sorry to share this, but after reviewing your account our team has flagged your case for an internal compliance review and the refund cannot be processed at this time. This is not a final decision, and our team will reach out to you within 5 to 7 business days with more information. I understand this is not the answer you were hoping for, and I appreciate your patience while we sort this out.

I've escalated your request to our management team and they are currently reviewing your case. You will receive an update within 5 to 7 business days regarding the refund decision. I appreciate your patience and I'm sorry for the inconvenience caused.
hi i give me the details of my product

I have great news for you. Our team has reviewed your case and approved a full refund of 42,999 rupees for your order. The refund will be processed back to your original payment method and you should see it reflect within a few business days. I sincerely apologize for the 471-day wait, this should never have happened and we truly regret the inconvenience caused.
